stuck.label: Why LUMI
stuck.title: She isn’t unable to use it. She’s afraid to ask.
stuck.quote: “That night I realized — my mom hasn’t asked me a question in a long, long time.”
stuck.body_p1: After being brushed off, cut off, or yelled at a few times, parents stop asking. “What does long-press mean?” “Where’s the verification code?” “How do I do a group chain message?” — they aren’t slow. They just don’t want to feel like a burden anymore.
stuck.body_p2: AI can give them the answer. It can’t give them the hand that walks them through.
stuck.tagline: LUMI sits on their screen — gently pointing to every next step, until the thing actually gets done.

advisor.headline: Heartfelt Recommendation
quotes: LUMI, LUMI — one tap and it just works. Phones, computers, it understands them all.
I recommend Infinity Agentic’s LUMI service — so no senior is left behind in the AI era.
Putting elders first is the path I most want to share.
advisor.full_speech:
LUMI, LUMI — one tap and it just works,
phones and computers, it understands them all.
Text too tiny, screens too cluttered, taps that lose their way,
LINE messages won’t send, photos won’t save.

It used to take a phone call — bothering my busy son.
Now it’s different. LUMI is right in your hand.
No need to wait for the weekend, no need to watch the clock.
It doesn’t mind if you’re slow — only if you don’t try.

LUMI, LUMI — speak slowly, it still understands.
Can’t open a video call? Forgot the password? No panic.
Browser pop-ups won’t startle you.
Just say "help me," and the answer is on its way.

I recommend Infinity Agentic’s LUMI service,
so no senior is left behind in the AI era.
Putting elders first — that’s the path I most want to share,
and the reason I recommend Infinity Agentic to every distinguished entrepreneur here.

When the phone won’t scroll, when the computer won’t start,
don’t be shy — just call LUMI.
It won’t rush you, won’t mind your many questions,
like an old friend who walks you through, step by step.

LUMI, LUMI — one tap and it just works.
LUMI, LUMI — always there in your hand.
My dear son, with LUMI now,
you really don’t have to bother again.
